palette.name: TNUA Kuandu observed entry cap silver gray
UNVERIFIED main walls entrance windows roofs neutral

limits: Cap roof upper skin, soffit, rear/left returns remain neutral.
Glass backing contains blinds, reflections and inner doors; do not paint solid blue.
Front and side frame domains remain neutral in this narrow review; no inferred metallic color through base/skirt transitions.
Left curved wall lower areas obscured by vegetation; brick inset partly covered by exhibition banners. No whole-wall white/red.
Low curved wall contains dark museum plaque; not uniformly white.
Stair treads, risers, terrace, skylight, rear curves, roof boundaries and all remaining faces remain neutral.
Only the existing upper fourth-floor entry/curved roof segment, not the whole museum/downhill storeys or neighboring research buildings.
Architect-source project evidence does not assign all historic exterior design authorship to that firm.
